name: baoyu-xhs-images
tagline_zh: 把长文一键拆成1-10张卡通图卡，12种画风+8种版式+3套配色，发小红书/微信图文，让读者刷到就想存。
tagline_en: Turn long text into 1-10 cartoon cards with 12 styles, 8 layouts, 3 palettes—made for Xiaohongshu & WeChat feeds.
desc_en: Generates infographic image card series with 12 visual styles, 8 layouts, and 3 color palettes. Breaks content into 1-10 cartoon-style image cards optimized for social media engagement. Use when user mentions "小红书图片", "小红书种草", "小绿书", "微信图文", "微信贴图", "image cards", "图片卡片", baoyu-xhs-images, or wants social media infographic series.
why_zh: 同类工具只出单图，它按社交传播节奏拆条，每张独立成梗，连发不重样。
why_en: Unlike tools that make one image, it splits content into scroll-stopping cards, each a standalone hook—endless variety.
